name: astranl-mcp
description: Dutch registered MCP server for AstraNL coordination protocol connecting humans AI agents and robots. Provides tools for robot index (46 robots across 11 categories), KvK compliance checks for Dutch companies, ACP v1.0 protocol primitives (DESCRIBE, MATCH, SHIELD, EXECUTE, SETTLE, LEARN), and multi AI consensus reviews. Production endpoint with 61 monitored organs and GDPR compliance.
